name: stockdex
description: Read-only stock prices, financial statements and dividends from Yahoo Finance and Digrin.
long_description: Stockdex gives Claude three read-only tools: historical daily OHLCV prices, income/cash flow/balance sheet metrics from Yahoo Finance, and dividend history from Digrin. Data is fetched on your computer; no API key is required.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Historical daily OHLCV bars from Yahoo Finance.

tools.name: get_financial_statement
tools.description: Income statement, cash flow or balance sheet metrics from Yahoo Finance.
